subject: Safeguard alignment + evidence & escrow plan for FinEx MAP
messages:
From: Alice Reynolds <alice.reynolds@finex.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: FinEx Security <security@finex.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Safeguard alignment + evidence & escrow plan for MAP

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. As we pull together the MAP for procurement, security has asked for a short evidence and escrow plan to sit in the MAP under the security gates. Two asks from our side to confirm early: 

1) SOC 2: is Redwood comfortable providing an on-demand SOC 2 summary and access to the SOC 2 report via an NDA channel once we reach legal review?
2) Data retention / escrow: FinEx needs an explicit retention window plus a plan for export (S3-compatible export) should we want to escrow customer data at time of contract exit.

I attached a draft MAP (FinEx_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) that includes a proposed timeline (we're targeting a signed contract by end of August). Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 evidence and the export format above work for Redwood, and whether any additional artifacts (SIG/CAIQ answers, DPA redline) would be required before we mark the security gate "green"?

Appreciate the quick confirmation.

Best,
Alice
Security Operations
FinEx Inc

Attachments: FinEx_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-summary.pdf (summary PDF)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Reynolds <alice.reynolds@finex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Safeguard alignment + evidence & escrow plan for MAP

Alice — thanks for the clear list and the MAP draft. Looping in Marissa (Customer Success) and Ben (Legal/Sales ops) so we can align timelines and what gets surfaced in the MAP.

Quick answers up front: 
- SOC 2: yes — we can provide a SOC 2 Type II report via secure link (NDA/portal). We can share a SOC2-summary.pdf immediately; the full report is available after an NDA is in place.
- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain an up-to-date SIG questionnaire. For MAP purposes we can attach the CAIQ export to the evidence bucket; if you want a tailored responses deck we can prioritize the most critical controls (data residency, access controls, key management).
- DPA: our standard DPA covers the retention categories but we often track one-off retention windows in the MAP. For escrow/export we support a gzipped ndjson export to S3.

Open questions: 
- FinEx retention window: you propose 7 years in the MAP. That will change a couple internal knobs (archival tiering / cost). Can you confirm target retention?
- Escrow timeline: do you want monthly exports, or a one-time export at contract termination?

I propose a short working session on Wednesday to finalize the MAP entries and lock the evidence artifacts. Marissa — can you propose 30 minutes? Ben — can you confirm if your team needs a specific DPA redline template before the session?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Reynolds <alice.reynolds@finex.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Safeguard alignment + evidence & escrow plan for MAP

Alice / Karthik — Marissa here. I took a pass on the MAP timeline in the spreadsheet and proposed a condensed evidence sprint to match your contract target. Summary of proposed changes: 

- Evidence sprint (week of 7/21): collect CAIQ export, SOC2 summary link, and DPA redline comments. 
- Tech validation (week of 7/28): 2 half-day sessions with FinEx security for config review (network controls, KMS screenshots).
- Escrow/export confirmation (week of 8/04): test a sample export (10k rows) delivered to a pre-provisioned S3 bucket and validated by FinEx.

Notes / asks: 
- Retention: if FinEx confirms 7 years, we will add an archival cost line item to the MAP. If you prefer a 3-year default with a contractual carveout for historical backups, note that in the MAP so legal can draft the exception.
- Artifacts: attaching a proposed evidence list and a short playbook we use for export testing (attachments).

Can we lock a 30-minute session on Wed 7/23 at 10am PT to finalize the sprint scope? Karthik / Ben can you confirm both are ok on that date.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-evidence-checklist.docx (doc), export-playbook.md (text)

From: FinEx Security <security@finex.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Reynolds <alice.reynolds@finex.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Safeguard alignment + evidence & escrow plan for MAP

Thanks all — short update from security review after the tech validation session this morning.

1) SOC 2: summary accepted; FinEx legal will route an NDA this week to pull the full report.
2) Retention: we will accept a contractual 3-year default with a 7-year archival carveout for regulatory data. Please reflect the following in the MAP: 
   - Primary retention: 3 years (active store)
   - Regulated archival: up to 7 years (cold storage)
   - Export format: gzipped ndjson to S3 (we tested a 10k row file; hash matched)
3) DPA: sending redlines to Ben by EOD for one round of review.

If Redwood can add the export-playbook.md and the MAP-evidence-checklist.docx into the MAP artifacts folder (Drive link above), we will consider the security gate satisfied pending legal signoff.

Regards,
FinEx Security Team

--
